decision: S1 bootstrap: pinned requirements.txt (opencv-contrib-python==4.10.0.84, numpy==2.0.2, Pillow==10.4.0); refactored FacialRecognition/{01,02,03}_*.py into an importable package -- FacialRecognition/__init__.py (CASCADE_PATH resolved from the package dir, not cwd) plus face_dataset.py, face_training.py, face_recognition.py -- with all camera/input()/display calls guarded under if __name__ == "__main__". Added a headless pytest smoke suite (8 tests) and root conftest.py for import resolution. Gates run: pip install -r requirements.txt (pass), python -c "import FacialRecognition" plus each of the 3 stage modules (pass, importable_pipeline_modules=3, meets S1 threshold 3/imports-clean), pytest -q (8 passed, tests_passing=8 which exceeds the S2 threshold of 6, though S2s specific dataset-writer/LBPH-train/recognizer round-trip fixture coverage is not yet built -- S2 not claimed done), ruff check on touched files clean (pre-existing FaceDetection/*.py F401 unused-numpy findings are untouched by this step, confirmed via git diff against the parent commit -- not a regression). cascade_asset_changed=false (haarcascade xml byte-identical to parent commit, abort predicate not triggered). S3 (recognition_accuracy_pct) not attempted this cycle: no bundled fixture gallery exists yet for a disjoint train/held-out split -- left for a future cycle.
subject: S1

gates.accuracy-gate: not-attempted (S3 out of scope this cycle)

decision: S2 coverage: added tests/test_facialrecognition_pipeline.py (4 new pytest cases) exercising the parts of the S2 criterion not yet covered by the S1-cycle smoke suite: capture_faces (dataset writer) writing cropped images from a stub camera/detector pair with show_window=False; train_recognizer (LBPH train) producing a trainer.yml from a synthetic two-id dataset via a monkeypatched build_face_detector stub; and a full train -> write -> load_recognizer -> recognize_face round trip asserting the correct id is predicted. Stubs avoid depending on real Haar-detectable faces in synthetic pixels, so the suite stays headless and deterministic. Gates run: pip install -r requirements.txt (pass), python -c imports of the package root plus all 3 stage modules (pass, importable_pipeline_modules=3, S1 still met), pytest -q (13 passed, up from 8; tests_passing=13 exceeds the S2 threshold of 6, and now the count reflects genuine coverage of cascade load + dataset writer + LBPH train + recognizer round-trip per the S2 sub_objective text, so S2/pytest-green is claimed done this cycle). ruff check .: 3 new findings were introduced by the new test file (import order, an aliased submodule import, an unused unpacked variable) and were fixed in a follow-up commit on the same branch; ruff check on the touched file is now clean. Pre-existing ruff findings in FaceDetection/*.py (F401 unused numpy) and the N999 module-name finding on FacialRecognition/__init__.py are untouched by this diff (confirmed via git diff against origin/master) -- not a regression. pytest -q -k accuracy still selects 0 tests (exit code 5, no accuracy-marked tests exist); this is the same pre-existing gap noted in D-260828-01, not introduced or worsened by this step -- S3 is still out of scope. cascade_asset_changed=false (haarcascade xml md5 identical to origin/master; abort predicate not triggered).
